visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A medium close-up shot features a male toddler with short dark hair, sitting in a yellow plastic high chair. He wears a cream bib decorated with small floral or fruit patterns. An adult's right hand enters from the left, holding a black DJI wireless microphone close to the child's mouth. The background shows an indoor domestic setting with posters on a white wall and a computer monitor. (2) The toddler receives a long, cylindrical, pale yellow rice cracker. He grips the cracker firmly with both hands, bringing it to his mouth and biting off pieces. Crumbs are visible on his bib and mouth as he chews. The lighting is bright and even, typical of indoor artificial light, casting soft shadows on the background. (3) The camera remains static as the toddler continues to munch on the cracker, looking off-camera with a neutral yet content expression. The adult's hand remains steady, keeping the microphone positioned to capture the sounds. Background elements include a bookshelf with various items and a desktop setup, providing a cluttered but warm home environment. (4) The toddler finishes eating and looks directly into the camera lens. He brings his right hand to his lips and performs a deliberate blowing kiss motion. Simultaneously, a bright red heart emoji overlay appears briefly near his hand. The scene ends with the toddler maintaining a soft, pleasant facial expression as the video concludes.
